Interface ScrollbarStyleSupported<T extends ScrollbarStyleSupported<T>>

All Known Implementing Classes:
CodeEditorBuilder, ContainerBuilder, DynamicImageBuilder, DynamicPaneBuilder, DynamicPaneContainerBuilder, GroupBuilder, HyvatarImageBuilder, ItemGridBuilder, PageOverlayBuilder, PanelBuilder, ProgressBarBuilder, ReorderableListBuilder, TextFieldBuilder
public interface ScrollbarStyleSupported<T extends ScrollbarStyleSupported<T>>
Interface for UI elements that support custom scrollbar styles.

      styleReference - The reference string (e.g., "ScrollbarStyleReferenceHere").
      Returns:
      This builder instance for method chaining.

    • withScrollbarStyle

      T withScrollbarStyle(String document, String styleReference)

      Parameters:
      document - The document path (e.g., "Common.ui").
      styleReference - The reference string (e.g., "ScrollbarStyleReferenceHere").
      Returns:
